name: fuel-gauge
description: Unofficial fuel gauge for Claude: it knows its own 5-hour and weekly limits, shows them next to your prompt and hard-stops at 95% so you never get cut off mid-task.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the bar, the panel and the notes Claude reads (en or pt for European Portuguese).

lockAt.title: Hard stop at (%)
lockAt.description: When any usage window reaches this percentage, tools and new requests are blocked until you say "continue".

warnAt.title: Warn at (%)
warnAt.description: Comma-separated percentages that raise a warning, e.g. 80,90.

contextLine.title: Tell Claude on every message
contextLine.description: Adds one short line with the limits to each message you send (about 50 tokens). Turn off to rely on the tool and the hard stop only.

gaugeArtifactUrl.title: Live gauge artifact URL (Cowork)
gaugeArtifactUrl.description: Optional. A claude.ai artifact built from artifact/fuel-gauge.html; the plugin keeps its dials up to date.

trayFile.title: Tray file path (Windows)
trayFile.description: Optional. Where to write usage.json for the Windows taskbar icon. Use one file per Claude account, e.g. C:\Users\you\AppData\Local\FuelGauge\usage.json.
